findings.title: Commissioning sequence omits actual authenticated PaperStart
findings.detail: configure-paper selects policies but creates no run; coordinator schedule_once explicitly never commands PaperStart. Step8 currently moves directly from configuration to run-product and says observation starts, so following the described normal sequence can leave runtime running with no Paper run or forward sample clock.
findings.minimal_repair: After actual qualified candidate/configuration and service startup, explicitly require normal authenticated UI/API PaperStart with exact selected strategy/version/policy, current expected_revision and stable command_id; verify accepted original run_id and actual owner attachment before calling observation started. Preserve current draft workflowfalse/start_allowedfalse and no selection/authority credit.
